marketing_description: The Milwaukee M12 Fuel Series 1/2 in square drive ratchet delivers up to 60 ft-lb of torque with a 12 V M12 battery and a 175 RPM speed rating. This tool features a low profile head design, a brushless motor, a variable speed metal trigger, a reinforced mechanism, and an integrated LED work light across its 12-1/2 in overall length.
